draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kalady! This is the birthplace of Adi Shankara, the 9th century philosopher. Kalady means 'footprint' in Malayalam, and the village was once called Sasalam.
draft.hungryLine: Kalady has plenty of hotels serving both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Sanskrit university is a 7 min walk. In town, find Sringeri Math on the Periyar's bank and the pink 8-storey Keerthi Sthambam.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Climb the Sri Adi Sankara Keerthi Sthambam for a view over palm-fringed green fields.
moodReplies.surprise-me: At Nayathodu Sankara Narayana Temple, Shiva gets the first offerings, then everything is cleared and Vishnu is worshipped at the very same idol.

legends.title: The crocodile ghat
legends.body: Young Sankara wanted to become a monk, but his mother said no. When a crocodile caught him in the river, she agreed, and the crocodile let him go.

legends.title: The river that moved
legends.body: Sankara's mother struggled to walk to the river, so Krishna blessed that it would flow where the boy marked with his feet. The village took its name, Kalady, from those feet.

tips.title: Everyone is welcome.
tips.body: Adi Sankara's shrines in Kalady are open to all pilgrims, whatever their religion or caste.

tips.title: Come for Navarathri.
tips.body: Sringeri Math holds a ten day festival with a temple chariot procession and classical music concerts.

story.title: A philosopher is born
story.body: Adi Shankara was born here and went on to preach Advaita philosophy.

story.title: A lamp for his mother
story.body: The Kappilly family lit a daily lamp at the cremation spot of Shankara's mother, Aryamba, for centuries.

story.title: Travancore steps in
story.body: The Maharaja of Travancore acquired Shankara's family property and handed it to the Sringeri Mutt.

story.title: A Sanskrit university
story.body: The Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit opened in Kalady.

story.title: A centenary
story.body: Kalady celebrated a hundred years since its rediscovery.
